questions.en: What did the gradual loss of Maria Clara's image cause?
questions.tl: Ano ang idinulot ng unti-unting pagkawala ng imaheng Maria Clara?
questions.correct: Nationalism, intellectual discourse, and an active role in society
questions.correctTl: Nasyonalismo, intelektwal na diskurso, at aktibong papel sa lipunan
questions.ex: II, III, and IV are the right combination.
questions.exTl: II, III, at IV ang tamang kombinasyon.

questions.en: What action did women take to promote equality?
questions.tl: Anong pagkilos ang isinagawa ng kababaihan upang itaguyod ang pagkakapantay-pantay?
questions.correct: They founded organizations to promote women's welfare
questions.correctTl: Nagtatag sila ng mga samahan upang isulong ang kapakanan ng kababaihan
questions.ex: Organizations promoted welfare and equality.
questions.exTl: Nagsulong ang mga samahan ng kapakanan at pagkakapantay-pantay.

questions.en: What has been the result of a more independent view of women?
questions.tl: Ano ang naging bunga ng mas malayang pagtingin sa kababaihan?
questions.correct: Had the opportunity to work in the office, teaching, and other professions
questions.correctTl: Nagkaroon ng pagkakataong magtrabaho sa opisina, pagtuturo, at iba pang propesyon
questions.ex: The source describes new professional opportunities.
questions.exTl: Inilalarawan ng source ang mga bagong oportunidad sa propesyon.

questions.en:
Statement I: Co-education introduced the joint education of boys and girls in private schools.

Statement II: The purpose of co-education is to separate boys' education from girls' education.

Which statement evaluation is correct?
questions.tl:
Pahayag I: Ipinakilala ang co-education o parehong pag-aaral para sa lalaki at babae sa mga pribadong paaralan.

Pahayag II: Layunin ng co-education na paghiwalayin ang pag-aaral ng mga lalaki at babae.

Alin ang tamang pagsusuri?
questions.correct: Both statements are false
questions.correctTl: Parehong mali ang mga pahayag
wrong: The first is true, the second is false
The first is false, the second is true
wrongTl: Tama ang una, mali ang ikalawa
Mali ang una, tama ang ikalawa
questions.ex: Co-education is not limited to private schools and it does not exclude gender.
questions.exTl: Hindi limitado sa pribadong paaralan ang co-education at hindi nito ibinubukod ang kasarian.

questions.en: What does co-education prove?
questions.tl: Ano ang pinatutunayan ng co-education?
questions.correct: Women were freer and more active during American colonialism
questions.correctTl: Mas malaya at aktibo ang kalagayan ng kababaihan noong kolonyalismong Amerikano
questions.ex: The item refers to the American period.
questions.exTl: Tumutukoy ang item sa panahon ng Amerikano.

questions.en: Why were women more free during the American era?
questions.tl: Bakit mas malaya ang kababaihan noong panahon ng Amerikano?
questions.correct: To raise the level of women in society
questions.correctTl: Upang iangat ang antas ng kababaihan sa lipunan
wrongTl: Upang lumikha ng baligtad na hierarchy
questions.ex: It aims to raise the status of women.
questions.exTl: Layunin nitong iangat ang katayuan ng kababaihan.

questions.en: What is the basis for considering the Filipino as the lowest class in society?
questions.tl: Ano ang batayan upang ituring ang Pilipino bilang pinakamababang uri sa lipunan?
questions.correct: Race
questions.correctTl: Lahi
questions.ex: Classification is based on race.
questions.exTl: Batay sa lahi ang pagkaklasipika.

questions.en: What did the Spanish want to promote in their treatment of the Filipinos?
questions.tl: Ano ang nais isulong ng Kastila sa kanilang pagtrato sa Pilipino?
questions.correct: Maintaining their power and governance
questions.correctTl: Pagpapanatili ng kanilang kapangyarihan at pamamahala
questions.ex: Colonial treatment established Spanish control.
questions.exTl: Pinatatag ng kolonyal na pagtrato ang kontrol ng Kastila.

questions.en: Which repressive policies did the Spanish implement?
questions.tl: Aling mapaniil na patakaran ang pinairal ng Kastila?
questions.correct: Forced labor, tribute, and taxes
questions.correctTl: Sapilitang paggawa, tributo, at buwis
questions.ex: The colonial government took advantage of and controlled these policies.
questions.exTl: Pinakinabangan at kinontrol ng kolonyal na pamahalaan ang mga patakarang ito.

questions.en: Which policy provided free labor for roads, bridges, and churches?
questions.tl: Aling patakaran ang nagbigay ng libreng paggawa para sa kalsada, tulay, at simbahan?
questions.correct: Forced labor of Filipino men age 16 to 60
questions.correctTl: Sapilitang paggawa ng mga lalaking Pilipino edad 16 hanggang 60
questions.ex: At Polo y Servicio, men age 16 to 60 were forced to work.
questions.exTl: Sa Polo y Servicio, sapilitang pinagtrabaho ang mga lalaki edad 16 hanggang 60.

questions.en: How did the Spaniards finance the road, bridge, and church?
questions.tl: Paano pinondohan ng Kastila ang kalsada, tulay, at simbahan?
questions.correct: In the collection of tribute and tax
questions.correctTl: Sa pangongolekta ng tributo at buwis
questions.ex: From tribute and tax the colonial fund.
questions.exTl: Mula sa tributo at buwis ang pondong kolonyal.

questions.en: What abuses did the friars commit?
questions.tl: Anong pang-aabuso ang ginawa ng mga prayle?
questions.correct: Excessive religious rites charges
questions.correctTl: Labis na singil sa mga relihiyosong ritwal
questions.ex: Excessive ritual charges are defined by the worksheet.
questions.exTl: Labis na singil sa ritwal ang tinukoy ng worksheet.

questions.en: Why are Filipinos called Indios?
questions.tl: Bakit tinawag na Indio ang mga Pilipino?
questions.correct: They are natives of pure local race with no Spanish or foreign admixture
questions.correctTl: Sila ay mga katutubong may purong lahing lokal na walang halong Kastila o banyaga
questions.ex: Indio is a colonial name for native Filipinos.
questions.exTl: Ang Indio ay kolonyal na tawag sa katutubong Pilipino.

questions.en: What was the main effect of the Spanish treatment?
questions.tl: Ano ang pangunahing epekto ng pagtrato ng Kastila?
questions.correct: Filipinos were set at the lowest level of society
questions.correctTl: Itinakda ang Pilipino sa pinakamababang antas ng lipunan
questions.ex: Filipinos' lowest status was institutionalized.
questions.exTl: Ginawang institusyon ang pinakamababang katayuan ng Pilipino.

questions.en: What could be the result of continued Spanish oppression?
questions.tl: Ano ang maaaring maging bunga ng nagpatuloy na pang-aapi ng Kastila?
questions.correct: Awakening of patriotism and awakening of nationalism
questions.correctTl: Pagkamulat ng patriotismo at pagkagising ng nasyonalismo
questions.ex: Oppression helped to awaken national consciousness.
questions.exTl: Nakatulong ang pang-aapi sa pagkagising ng kamalayang pambansa.

questions.en: What is the reason for the unequal treatment of Spaniards and Filipinos?
questions.tl: Ano ang dahilan ng hindi pantay na pagtrato ng Kastila sa Pilipino?
questions.correct: Division of society based on race
questions.correctTl: Pagkakahati-hati ng lipunan batay sa lahi
questions.ex: Hierarchy was formed based on race.
questions.exTl: Nabuo ang hierarchy batay sa lahi.

questions.en:
Statement I: Peninsulares and Insulares occupied the highest social level compared with Filipinos.

Statement II: Native Filipinos or Indios occupied the middle social level, with Chinese and Japanese below them.

Which statement evaluation is correct?
questions.tl:
Pahayag I: Nasa pinakamataas na antas ng lipunan ang mga Peninsulares at Insulares kung ihahambing sa mga Pilipino.

Pahayag II: Nasa kalagitnaang antas ng lipunan ang mga katutubong Pilipino o Indio at nasa ilalim nila ang Intsik at Hapones.

Alin ang tamang pagsusuri?
questions.correct: The first one is correct; the second is wrong
questions.correctTl: Tama ang una; mali ang ikalawa
wrong: The first is wrong; the second is correct
wrongTl: Mali ang una; tama ang ikalawa
questions.ex: Peninsulares and Insulares are above; Indio is at the bottom, not in the middle.
questions.exTl: Nasa itaas ang Peninsulares at Insulares; nasa pinakamababa ang Indio, hindi sa gitna.

questions.en: What did the claim of uplifting the Spanish cause?
questions.tl: Ano ang idinulot ng pag-aangking nakakaangat ang Kastila?
questions.correct: Abuse or excess of power
questions.correctTl: Pang-aabuso o pagmamalabis sa kapangyarihan
questions.ex: It caused the misuse of colonial power.
questions.exTl: Nagdulot ito ng maling paggamit ng kapangyarihang kolonyal.

questions.en: What belief placed the man at a high level in the family and society?
questions.tl: Anong paniniwala ang naglagay sa lalaki sa mataas na antas sa pamilya at lipunan?
questions.correct: Patriyarka
questions.correctTl: Patriyarka
questions.ex: The patriarchy favors the man in society and family.
questions.exTl: Kinakampihan ng patriyarka ang lalaki sa lipunan at pamilya.

questions.en: Which characteristic describes the ideal Maria Clara?
questions.tl: Aling katangian ang naglalarawan sa ideyal na Maria Clara?
questions.correct: Modest, humble, and calm
questions.correctTl: Mahinhin, mapagpakumbaba, at mahinahon
questions.ex: Only I, II, and III are included in the correct answer.
questions.exTl: I, II, at III lamang ang kasama sa tamang sagot.
